description: Script-integrity-hash / languageViews / cost-model differential (cardano 11.1.2 vs amaru 0925). script_data_hash = hash(redeemers||datums||languageViews). Result: amaru computes the same script_data_hash as cardano for single-V1, single-V3, and MIXED V1+V3 (both cost models in languageViews) -- all accept with the same txid -- and both reject a corrupted hash (PPViewHashesDontMatch). No integrity-hash / cost-model-inclusion consensus divergence. Boundary: PlutusV2 has no cost model on this chain, so V1+V3 (and their mix) are the reachable languages.

cases.note: mint under a PlutusV1 always-succeeds policy -> languageViews carries the V1 cost model; both accept (same script_data_hash)
mint under a PlutusV3 always-succeeds policy (control) -> both accept
ONE tx minting under BOTH a V1 and a V3 policy -> languageViews must carry BOTH cost models; both accept, same txid -> inclusion/ordering/encoding of the two cost models matches
mixed-v1v3 with one bit flipped in the body script_data_hash + re-signed -> both reject PPViewHashesDontMatch (both compute + check the hash)
